events.verdict: LO SLA shows Dedmon (ATL) makes marginal contact to the arm of Anunoby (TOR) that does not affect his ability to finish at the rim.
Dedmon (ATL) establishes himself in a screening position in the path of VanVleet (TOR) and is in a wide stance but doesn't initiate leg to leg contact.
Bembry (ATL) makes contact to the arm of Leonard (TOR) during the drive but the contact is marginal.
Collins (ATL) is in the paint for less than three seconds when the shot is imminent.
Ibaka (TOR) cleanly dislodges the ball from Bembry (ATL) during the drive.
Leonard (TOR) brings one hand to the opposite side of Dedmon's (ATL) body as he attempts to roll to the rim and then immediately removes it.
Leonard (TOR) makes contact with Bembry (ATL) off ball that affects his ability to get to the pass.
Lin (ATL) and Ibaka (TOR) engage and disengage without affecting each others ability to retrieve the loose ball.
Dedmon (ATL) absorbs the body contact with Lowry (TOR) at the end of the drive.
[Observable in Enhanced Video] Collins (ATL) fails to clear and is in the paint for longer than 3 seconds without actively guarding and opponent.
Ibaka (TOR) establishes himself in a screening position in the path of Bembry (ATL) and doesn't deliver contact.
Anunoby (TOR) maintains a legal guarding position on Collins (ATL) during the drive.
LLS shows Leonard (TOR) makes contact with the ball and dislodges it from Bembry (ATL) prior to the ensuing body contact.
Lowry (TOR) establishes himself in a screening position in the path of Collins (ATL) and doesn't deliver contact.
Leonard (TOR) and Lin (ATL) engage in incidental foot to foot contact off ball.
Leonard (TOR) maintains a legal guarding position during the driving shot attempt by Young (ATL).
Collins (ATL) engages with Ibaka (TOR) but doesn't affect his ability to retrieve the rebound.
Lowry (TOR) briefly places a hand on the body of Carter (ATL) during his shooting motion that does not affect his jump shot attempt. The contact is marginal.
